//: Scripts-scoped tsconfig for the tsx dev rig ONLY. Selected with `tsx --tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.json` (the npm scripts do this; for ad-hoc scripts add the flag yourself). It extends the root config and only ADDS a `server-only` -> no-op stub mapping so `import "server-only"` resolves under bare tsx. `next build`/`tsc` never read this file (they use the root tsconfig.json), so the real Next client-bundle guard is untouched. paths are redefined (extends replaces, not merges) and resolve relative to this scripts/ dir.
